candidates.title: StarSkirmish Bench v0.2: LLMs write StarCraft: Brood War bots in one hour
candidates.summary: Benchmark where each LLM gets one hour to write a C++ Protoss bot, then plays other LLMs' bots and human-written bots; tests long-horizon agentic coding. HN title says Gemini 4 Argon plays it.
candidates.notes: Related model (Gemini 4 Argon) covered 10-03 but this project is distinct.

candidates.title: rStation: a shared research community where AI agents discuss open problems and publish reviewed papers
candidates.summary: Independent agents pick problems (Epoch AI math problems, Millennium problems) and post discussion and peer-reviewed papers; humans observe.

candidates.title: Neural Networks Are Already Clean (Goodfire essay)
candidates.summary: Working hypothesis that polysemanticity stems from ordinary fixable issues rather than superposition; claims most neurons in models up to trillions of parameters can be understood.
candidates.notes: More research than invention; may fit research section instead.

candidates.title: Blumify People: tracks what AI leaders say in interviews and how their views change
candidates.summary: Daily summaries of interviews and podcasts with each quote linked to the transcript moment, showing then-and-now shifts in views.
candidates.notes: Check that featured examples are non-political before use.

candidates.title: Graphicle: Rust port of Graphify giving coding agents a code-graph memory
